direction.label: Immediate flow
direction.question: How are the cards inside the outlined frame arranged?

options.row: Side by side in one horizontal row

distribution.label: Main-axis distribution
distribution.question: Consider the sequence of cards along its long direction inside the outlined frame. Start means left for a row and top for a column. Which description fits the empty spaces measured from card edges to the INSIDE of the frame border?

options.start: Packed at the start, touching that inner edge
options.center: Packed together in the middle, with much larger equal outer spaces
options.end: Packed at the end, touching that inner edge
options.between: First and last cards touch opposite inner edges; equal gaps between cards
options.around: Equal outer spaces, each half the size of an interior gap
options.evenly: All interior gaps and both outer spaces are equal

crossalign.label: Cross-axis alignment
crossalign.question: Across the direction perpendicular to the sequence of cards, how do their visible boxes align inside the outlined frame? For a horizontal sequence compare vertical positions; for a vertical sequence compare horizontal positions.

options.start: Every box touches the top (horizontal sequence) or left (vertical sequence) inner edge, leaving space before the opposite edge
options.center: Every box is centered on that cross axis, with empty space on both sides of the box
options.end: Every box touches the bottom (horizontal sequence) or right (vertical sequence) inner edge, leaving space before the opposite edge
options.stretch: Every box fills the frame along that cross axis

textalign.label: Text justification
textalign.question: How are the lines of body text aligned within the outlined text region? For both-edge justification, disregard the short final line.

options.left: Left edges line up; right edges are ragged
options.center: Line centers line up; both edges are ragged
options.right: Right edges line up; left edges are ragged
options.justify: Both left and right edges line up on the nonfinal lines

textcolumns.label: Text columns
textcolumns.question: How many side-by-side columns of body text are visible inside the frame?

gridcols.label: Grid columns
gridcols.question: How many columns of cards are in the rectangular grid? Count the cards across one complete row.

gridrows.label: Grid rows
gridrows.question: How many rows of cards are in the rectangular grid? Count the cards down one complete column.

gridgaps.label: Grid gutter comparison
gridgaps.question: Compare the horizontal empty gutters between columns with the vertical empty gutters between rows. Measure between the visible card boxes.

options.equal: The two gutter sizes are equal

gridtracks.label: Grid track proportions
gridtracks.question: Compare the widths of the three card columns in this grid.

options.equal: All three columns have equal widths
options.left: The left column is wider; the other two have equal widths
options.right: The right column is wider; the other two have equal widths

gridspan.label: Column span
gridspan.question: Use the three equal-width cards in the lower row as column guides. How many of those column positions does the single card in the upper row cover, including any intervening gutters?

wrapcount.label: Wrapped row count
wrapcount.question: How many horizontal rows of small cards are visible inside the frame?

wrapalign.label: Incomplete row alignment
wrapalign.question: Look only at the shorter final row of cards. How is that row placed horizontally inside the outlined frame?

options.center: Centered, with equal empty space on either side

gapcompare.label: Neighboring gap comparison
gapcompare.question: Compare the two empty gaps between the three card boxes, reading left to right for a row or top to bottom for a column.

padcompare.label: Horizontal versus vertical inset
padcompare.question: The tinted rectangle is centered inside the outlined frame. Compare the horizontal inset (frame to rectangle on either side) with the vertical inset (frame to rectangle above or below). Measure to the rectangle's visible outer edge, not to its text.

options.equal: The horizontal and vertical insets are equal

blockalign.label: Text block placement
blockalign.question: Where is the tinted text block placed horizontally within the outer frame? Judge the block's outer edges, independently of how its text lines align.

options.center: Centered, with equal empty space on either side

widthcompare.label: Relative panel width
widthcompare.question: Compare the widths of the two tinted panels, from their visible left edge to right edge.

groupgap.label: Spacing within and between groups
groupgap.question: The cards form two groups marked Harbor and Meadow. Compare the gap between the groups' nearest card boxes with the gaps between cards within each group. Ignore the small group captions.

options.equal: The between-group and within-group gaps are equal

topflow.label: Top-level hierarchy
topflow.question: Look at the two large outlined sections headed Field notes and Harbor log. At the top level, how are these two sections arranged? Ignore the arrangement of cards inside either section.

nestedflow.label: Nested section flow
nestedflow.question: Look inside the large section headed Field notes. How are its small cards arranged? Ignore how Field notes is placed relative to Harbor log.

options.wrapped: Multiple horizontal rows, with a shorter final row

nestedwrap.label: Nested incomplete row alignment
nestedwrap.question: Inside Field notes, look only at the shorter final row of cards. How is it placed horizontally inside its own outlined inner frame? Ignore the surrounding page's arrangement.

options.left: Against that frame's left inner edge
options.right: Against that frame's right inner edge
